description_en: Sets a secure phone number for a member of the resource account type
description_zh: 调用BindSecureMobilePhone为资源账号类型的成员设置安全手机号码
name: BindSecureMobilePhone

parameters.help_en:
The verification code.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/372556.html to obtain the verification code
parameters.help_zh:
验证码。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/372556.html获取验证码
parameters.name: verification_code

parameters.help_en:
The secure phone number.

The phone number must be the same as the one that you specified when you called https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/372556.html to authenticate and obtain the verification code.

Format: <Country code>-<Phone number>.

<props="china">
Only the Chinese mainland phone numbers in the `86-<Phone number>` format are supported.</props>


<props="intl">
The Chinese mainland phone numbers in the `86-<Phone number>` format are not supported.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
安全手机号码。

该手机号码必须与https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/372556.html中获取验证码时设置的手机号码一致。

格式：<国家码>-<手机号码>。

<props="china">
仅支持填写`86-<手机号码>`的中国内地手机号码。</props>


<props="intl">
不支持填写`86-<手机号码>`的中国内地手机号码。</props>
parameters.name: secure_mobile_phone
